name: superbot
description: superbot is your own AI agent: one model that makes pictures, video, songs, 3D and apps, browses the web and uses your computer, on desktop and phone. This plugin adds its one MCP tool, superbot, and a skill that shows Codex how to use it.

interface.shortDescription: Your own AI agent, as one MCP tool and a skill
interface.longDescription: superbot is your own AI agent: one model that makes pictures, video, songs, 3D and apps, browses the web and uses your computer, on desktop and phone. This plugin connects Codex to its one MCP tool, superbot, which takes a request in plain words and hands back a finished result.
defaultPrompt: Use superbot to search the web for current information on a topic I name.
Ask superbot what it can do for a task I describe.
